heard: A truck-sized space rock bounced right off Earth's atmosphere. On August 10, 1972, the massive object entered the upper sky over Utah in broad daylight. It moved at an incredible blazing speed of about 15 kilometers per second across the western states. Cameras in Wyoming captured the glowing fireball as startled witnesses heard tremendous double sonic booms echo below. The entire dramatic atmospheric passage lasted approximately 100 seconds from start to finish. Instead of crashing into the terrain, the heavy rock climbed right back out into space over Alberta, Canada. No fragments ever landed because a colossal truck-sized space rock bounced right off Earth's atmosphere.
